public.title: Merge k Sorted Lists
public.description: Each inner array represents one sorted singly linked list in head-to-tail order. Return one ascending array containing every value, including duplicates. This value-only adaptation does not require node reuse. There are 0 to 100 lists with at most 1000 total integers, each between -10000 and 10000.
hints: Combine all list values and preserve duplicate occurrences.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: The direct reference flattens and sorts all values. Time O(total values times log total values), space O(total values).
